regimeSub: Q2 GDP slows to 1.5% as Fed holds with 3 hawkish dissents; stagflation narrative gaining traction.
themes: Q2 GDP prints 1.5% YoY (Jul 30) vs prior ~2% → imports drag but domestic demand 'robust' per Reuters; growth slowdown crystallizes stagflation risk with CPI still at 3.5%

Fed Chair Warsh holds rates (Jul 29) with 3 dissents voting hike → signals 'Big Picture' Jackson Hole speech, 'not constrained by market prices' per Chosun (Jul 30); hawkish bias intact despite growth miss
BOK hike path intact as Korea Times (Jul 30) flags 'Fed freeze intensifies uncertainty' → rate diff narrowing supports KRW to 1432; Rhee likely to hike Aug as domestic inflation remains sticky
VIX collapses to 17.09 from 20.66 as Q2 GDP shows consumer resilience despite headline miss → Brent eases to $87.98 (-$1.81) as Hormuz normalization continues, gold bid at $4140 on stagflation hedge
